newsitem.title: USA: First Brands sets restructuring, Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: First Brands sets restructuring, Q4 charge.

text.p: First Brands Corp Friday said it was starting an operational restructuring program intended to reduce ongoing costs and improve operating efficiencies and would record a pre-tax charge to earnings of $19.0 million -- $11.6 million after tax or $0.28 per share -- in its fourth quarter.

The consumer products company said in a press release that as a result of this restructuring, net annual savings of approximately $4.5 million pre-tax -- $2.7 million after tax or $0.07 per share -- are expected to be fully realized in the fiscal year ending June 30, 1999.

The company said the restructuring charge largely relates to the closing of a distribution facility and an adjacent office center, and the associated writedown of the property value, as well as the relocation of certain operations to less costly and more efficient locations.
Additionally, the charge includes a company-wide early retirement program announced in late June, First Brands said.
